outcome: gut microbial colonization (Staphylococcus, Proteobacteria, Bifidobacterium, Staphylococcaceae)
cohort: The study included 53 very preterm infants born at less than 30 weeks of gestation.
finding: The study found a link between diet (breastfeeding vs. supplemented feeding), microbial composition, and tryptophan metabolism in very preterm infants during their first month of life.
mod_finding: Cesarean delivery was associated with elevated host-derived kynurenine metabolites.
